title: Markers and Routes
summary: A marker is a promise. A route is the argument against dying there.
body: HoloMap markers show leads, hazards, missions, and discovered route points.
Routes are not safety. They are a chance to prepare before distance becomes a problem.
steps: Review hazard markers near the route.
Pack filters, water, and recovery supplies.
commonMistakes: Following a marker without reading nearby hazards.
